.`encrypt is idempotent and never re-encrypts already encrypted text`()
.`encrypt returns empty string when given empty input`()
.`decrypt returns original text when text is not encrypted`()
.`decrypt with invalid key fails authentication and returns fallback message`()
.`decrypt returns fallback message when ciphertext is tampered`()
.`decrypt handles malformed base64 and truncated payload gracefully`()
.`random IV ensures identical plaintext produces distinct ciphertexts`()
